name: Case of the Drowned Jeweler
source:
Handriel is the president of the Aedrisean Investigation Agency, though that doesn’t mean he stays in an office all day. In fact, he often makes time to go out and do some cases on his own, which led him to a small fishing town where a murder just took place…

[From [url=https://moonlightgardens.itch.io/case-of-the-drowned-jeweler]itch.io[/url]]
